title: Furry AI Art Generator
summary: Free furry AI art generator: design an original fursona in cartoon, anime, painterly or 3D style, make a reference sheet and keep it the same in every scene.
body_markdown:
### Is there a free furry AI art generator?


Yes. Flick is free to start: the free plan gives 100 credits every day with no credit card, and GPT Image 2.6, which made every character on this page, costs 5 credits an image.


### What is a fursona?


A fursona is an anthropomorphic animal character that a person designs to represent themselves, usually with a chosen species, fur colours, markings, clothes and personality, and often shown on a reference sheet so artists can draw it the same way.


### How do I make my own fursona with AI?


Describe the species, the main fur colour and where it changes, one or two unique markings, the eye colour and a full outfit, pick an art style, then generate a few versions and keep the one that feels most like you.


### How do I make a fursona reference sheet with AI?


Add your favourite design as a reference image and ask for a turnaround of front, three-quarter, side and back views at the same scale, a row of expressions and colour swatches, all on a plain white background.


### Can AI keep my fursona consistent across images?


Yes, when every new image uses the reference sheet as a reference image and the prompt repeats the same markings and outfit; GPT Image 2.6 takes up to 10 reference images, so you can add the sheet and a close-up together.


### Can I use my own drawing of my character?


Yes. Upload your drawing or a commissioned picture as a reference image, describe what must stay, such as the markings and colours, and describe the new scene or art style you want.


### What art styles work for furry art?


Most styles work when you name them: flat cartoon, anime, comic book inks, gouache, watercolour, painterly digital art, chibi and textured 3D animation renders.


### Can I animate my furry character?


Yes. Use a finished image as the start frame of an image to video model in Flick and describe one simple action, such as strumming a guitar or a tail swaying, and ask it to keep the character and the art style exactly as drawn.
